scope: Paired screening of all adopted LISA VI and LVK sensitivity fits, the controlled VI/independent fits and NUTS reference, and the three accepted external-comparison copula posteriors. Reuse saved draws, observations, event clouds and injection arrays. No fitting, new observations, new PE draws or GP refitting.
sampling_rule: For each existing MCMC chain take 32 evenly spaced retained draws, preserving chain identities; take 32 evenly spaced saved draws per VI fit. Retain existing numerical-refinement weights. Do not select draws using truth, updated weights or predictive scores.
interpretation: This is an impact screen, not posterior certification or a replacement scientific comparison. Ratios on VI draws measure target perturbation, not correction of VI error. Subset MCMC ratios require full-chain and integration checks before publication. GP targets and saved observations do not involve the repaired bounded density; compare updated copula predictions against the frozen GP predictions at the same events.
historical_mapping: Use executable historical core.py and analysis adapters without editing their hashes. Separate the float32-to-float64 evaluation change, the density/transform repair at matched physical bounds and fixed selection nodes, and the small original-bound rounding change. Remove the known historical event-factor N*log(volume) constant before comparing targets.
